backup_to_nas.help:
§7------§rMCDR Backup To Nas§7------§r
Back up worlds as ZIP archives and upload them to a NAS via SFTP.
§aCommands§r
§7{prefix}§r Show help
§7{prefix} make§r Create and upload a backup
§7{prefix} interval <interval>§r Set the backup interval, e.g. 1s|1h|1d
§7{prefix} interval off§r Disable automatic backups
§7{prefix} status§r Show SFTP upload progress
§7{prefix} upload§r Upload archives from the temporary directory
backup_to_nas.interval_invalid: The backup interval must be a positive number followed by s, h or d, e.g. 30s.
backup_to_nas.permission_invalid: permissions.{name} must be an integer from 0 to 4
backup_to_nas.denied_help: §cYou do not have permission to use this command.§r
backup_to_nas.denied_make: §cYou do not have permission to create backups.§r
backup_to_nas.denied_interval: §cYou do not have permission to change the backup interval.§r
backup_to_nas.denied_status: §cYou do not have permission to query upload status.§r
backup_to_nas.denied_upload: §cYou do not have permission to upload temporary files.§r
backup_to_nas.sftp_missing: {field} is not configured; cannot upload the backup.
backup_to_nas.credentials_invalid: Configure exactly one valid value for sftp.password_file or sftp.private_key_file.
backup_to_nas.key_missing: Private key file does not exist: {path}
backup_to_nas.status_idle: No SFTP upload has been started yet.
backup_to_nas.busy: §cA backup or upload is already in progress. Please try again later.§r
backup_to_nas.temp_missing: The temporary directory does not exist.
backup_to_nas.no_archives: No .zip files found in the temporary directory.
backup_to_nas.upload_unloaded: Plugin unloaded; remaining uploads have been cancelled.
backup_to_nas.upload_summary: Temporary file uploads finished: {succeeded} succeeded, {failed} failed.
backup_to_nas.temp_read_failed: Failed to read the temporary directory
backup_to_nas.compress_completed: Archive §acompleted§r in the temporary directory, took {seconds} seconds.
